items: At 19:33 ET, at the end of a work session, the company's file guard put back a file that only the Investors edit (Commandment 2): amendments.md. Who made the change: a work session's own commit (Operator, saying "amendments: an Investor 2026-11-03 19:16, usage tracks the week elapsed (#41 c6618916891); lock-in for today"). The guard took the new amendment out because the quoted words aren't in the message at its link. If you approve, amendments.md gets the change shown below (6 lines added, 0 removed), written to GitHub from your own account. If you disapprove, amendments.md stays as it is now, without this change. Recommended: Disapprove, unless you asked for this change, because work sessions may not edit these files (Commandment 2).
Approve or Disapprove on Home > Issues, with your token saved.

Purchase: a 1 TB external SSD for the Mac mini, about $220
